newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish repo allocates 14.5 bln SKR to market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish repo allocates 14.5 bln SKR to market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it allocated 14.5 billion crowns to the market in its weekly repurchase operation.
The one-week repo was set at an unchanged, fixed rate of 4.10 percent as expected by the market and will run from July 23 to July 30.
The operation replaces an earlier allocation of 13.5 billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 58.0 percent of the bids for this week's tender were allocated.
